# Panel

A full-height layer beside or over the Page with no Backdrop. Two floating types: Details and Notifications. The AI panel is a region of the Frame.

**Kind:** Template

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/patterns/Panel/Panel.mdx`

## Types

Both open on the right with no Backdrop: docked at an edge line from 1168 and floating over the Page below that. Floating at every width is Planned.

- **Details.** A quick look at a row, floating over the right of the Page. The picked row stays highlighted.
- **Notifications.** The Inbox, opened from the Bell. It lists items by time and stays open as you pick one.

## Anatomy

### Details

Opened from a session row. The page behind stays usable.

1. **Splitter.** On the Page-facing edge; it resizes from 320 to 640.
2. **Header.** The title names the record, with its status in the Subheader row under it; then the fixed actions: Up, Down, More, Close.
3. **Body.** The record's Sections. It scrolls between the header and the footer.

The picked row stays highlighted on the page while the Panel is open.

### Notifications

Picking an item opens its page behind the Panel and marks it read. The Inbox stays open.

1. **Header.** The title, a filter (Unread, All, Mentions), Archive all and Close.
2. **Items.** Avatar, who did what and where, a one-line excerpt and the time. An unread item ends in a dot, paired with the word "unread" for a screen reader.

The Bell in the Sidebar, with its unread count, opens the Inbox. It sits with the Sidebar and is Planned with the Inbox's placement.

## Width behavior

Drag the Frame's width. From 1168 a 400 Panel docks beside the Page at an edge line with no shadow. Under it the Panel floats on the overlay fill and shadow, capped at 320 under 1024 and full width under 768. It never has a Backdrop.

## Key states

### Beside the AI panel

A floating Panel and the docked AI panel sit side by side, and the AI panel is never covered. The Frame has one Panel area today, so this pair is Planned.

## Sizes

| Token | Value | Used for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--panel-width-default` | 400 | The width a Panel opens at. |
| `--panel-min-width` | 320 | The narrowest, and the cap under 1024. |
| `--space-300` | 48 | The full-bleed footer's height, shown only while editing. |
| `--ds-surface-overlay`, `--ds-shadow-overlay` | pair | The floating Panel's fill and elevation. A docked Panel uses `--ds-surface` and an edge line. |
| `--ds-border` | 1 | The edge line where a docked Panel meets the Page. |

The Panel resizes from 320 to 640 by drag or keys, never past what keeps 720 of content beside it.

## Slots

```jsx
import { PanelContainer, PanelHeader, PanelBody, PanelFooter } from '@/components';
import { Frame } from '@/patterns';
```

The Panel components are the parts: header with its fixed actions, body, footer, and Escape to close. The Frame hosts one and decides whether it docks or floats. The template is its filled layout, one per type. The AI panel is the Frame's `panel`.

| Slot | Details | Notifications |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | The record's name, with its StatusTag under it | "Inbox" |
| `actions` | Up, Down, More and Close | A filter (Select), Archive all and Close |
| `body` | Sections of the record; the form while editing | Items grouped by time |
| `footer` | Only while editing: Cancel and Save, full bleed. The page composes it from Button. Planned as a prop. | None |
| Placement | Floating, right. Floats under 1168; at 1168 and up the Frame docks it. Floating at every width is Planned. | Floating, left, out of the Sidebar. Planned. Today it uses the right-hand area. |
| Beside the AI panel | Planned. The Frame has one Panel area. | Planned. |

## Usage

Use a Panel when content is read beside the page and outlives a click: a quick look at a row, a short edit with the table in view, the Inbox. It never has a Backdrop, so the page behind stays usable. Details floats over the right of the Page; the Inbox floats out of the Sidebar on the left. One floating Panel is open at a time; opening another replaces it.

The AI panel is not a floating Panel. It is a region of the Frame, docked where there is room, so it persists across pages.

## Alternatives

- For a decision that must happen before the page continues, use `Modal`.
- For a queue page, use a `Section` detail: the record in place beside its list.
- For a short aside off a control, use `Popup`.
- For complex or multistep work, give the record its own page with `Frame` · focused.

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Title Details with the record: "Ana Ruiz · Thu 4:00 PM". | "Details". |
| Name the filter by what it keeps: "Unread". | "Filter". |
| Give the empty state a way back: "Back to sessions". | "Nothing here". |
| Name the footer's actions: "Cancel" and "Save". | "OK" and "Done". |

## Accessibility

- Floating, the Panel is a complementary landmark named by its title, after the Page in reading order. Focus moves to its title on open and returns to the row, or the Bell, on close.
- Under 1024 it is a dialog: focus is trapped, and Escape, a press outside or Close return it.
- Escape closes the Panel unless an inner control handles it, such as an open menu.
- Up and Down are named "Previous" and "Next" and announce the record that opens.
- An unread dot is paired with the text "unread" for a screen reader.

## Related

- Frame: use when the question is the AI panel, which is a Frame region.
- Section: use when the record belongs beside its list on a queue page.
- Modal: use when the task needs full attention.
- Form: use when the Panel edits a record.
- Patterns: use when you need the rules around a Panel: Navigation, Empty, Notifications.

## Motion

Panel reads these motion tokens and no literal duration or curve.

| Event | Transition | Tokens | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| docked-enter | Dock and undock a panel | `--ds-motion-spatial-slow` · `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | The AI Panel slides in from its edge while the page makes room; its content fades in once the page is about 90% done. A docked Panel never has a Backdrop. |
| docked-exit | Dock and undock a panel | `--ds-motion-spatial-default` | Reverses and stays at the edge. |
| floating-enter | Dock and undock a panel | `--ds-motion-spatial-default` | Details and the Inbox slide in from their edge over the page; the Inbox grows out of the Sidebar from the left. A quick look promoted to its record grows from the Panel itself. |
| floating-exit | Dock and undock a panel | `--ds-motion-spatial-fast` | Reverses. |
| narrow-enter | Open and close an overlay | `--ds-motion-spatial-slow` | At narrow widths it slides over with a Backdrop. |
| narrow-exit | Open and close an overlay | `--ds-motion-spatial-default` | The same way back. |

## Best practices

### Float a Panel with no Backdrop. {#float-a-panel-with-no-backdrop}

**Checked:** Automatic

The page keeps scrolling and stays clickable. A press on the page outside the Panel, or Escape, closes it. Under 1024 it is capped at 320, and under 768 it takes the whole width, still with no Backdrop. A confirm Modal over a Panel brings its own Backdrop.

Do: The Panel floats on its shadow and the page beside it stays undimmed.
Don't: The same Panel with a Backdrop dimming the whole page.

### Open one floating Panel at a time. {#open-one-floating-panel-at-a-time}

**Checked:** Automatic

Another row swaps the content; the Inbox replaces Details. The overlay module keeps a second overlay closed.

Do: One Panel; another row swaps what it shows.
Don't: Two Panels open at once, the second covering the first.

### Keep the picked row highlighted while Details is open. {#keep-the-picked-row-highlighted-while-details-is-open}

**Checked:** Review

Picking the same row again closes it; Up and Down step through the rows.

### Show a footer only while editing. {#show-a-footer-only-while-editing}

**Checked:** Review

Cancel (Default) and Save (Primary), full bleed. Reading needs no footer.

Do: Reading: a header and a body, nothing to save.
Don't: A footer of buttons on a Panel that is only read.

### Leave the AI panel uncovered. {#leave-the-ai-panel-uncovered}

**Checked:** Review

A floating Panel and the docked AI panel sit side by side. The AI panel is never covered. This pair is Planned.

Do: The floating Panel beside the docked AI panel, both fully visible.
Don't: The floating Panel drawn over the AI panel, hiding part of it.

### Move a Panel that needs full attention into a Modal. {#move-a-panel-that-needs-full-attention-into-a-modal}

**Checked:** Review

If the person must not look at anything outside it, it is a Modal.

### Grow the Inbox out of the Sidebar. {#grow-the-inbox-out-of-the-sidebar}

**Checked:** Review

Its left edge sits against the Sidebar, over the left of the Page. Picking an item opens its page behind the Inbox, which stays open. Flags still show at the top right. This placement is Planned.

### Title the Panel with the object. {#title-the-panel-with-the-object}

**Checked:** Review

"Session · Mar 4", not "Details", so someone who opened it from elsewhere still knows.

### Offer "Open as page" in More. {#offer-open-as-page-in-more}

**Checked:** Review

For the step up when the quick look is not enough.
